RELACIONAMENTOS_TRAZER.TITULO: Bring your list. We'll sort it out.
RELACIONAMENTOS_TRAZER.SEM_ACESSO: You can't bring lists into this account. Ask whoever manages the account.

ENVIAR.SOLTAR: Drag the spreadsheet here or click to choose
ENVIAR.APOIO: Excel or CSV. It needs a name and a phone or e-mail.
ENVIAR.ERRO_TIPO: This file is not a spreadsheet. Use Excel or CSV.
ENVIAR.ERRO_GRANDE: This spreadsheet is too big. Send it in smaller parts.
ENVIAR.ERRO_SEM_CONTATO: I couldn't find a phone or an e-mail I can use in this spreadsheet. The phone must be a mobile number, with the area code together with the number, in the same column. Fix the spreadsheet and send it again.
ENVIAR.ERRO_DEMOROU: I haven't finished reading your spreadsheet yet.
ENVIAR.ERRO_SEM_NINGUEM: With that change there was no one left with a phone or e-mail. Send the spreadsheet again.
ENVIAR.ERRO_VENCIDA: This spreadsheet was sent more than 7 days ago and has already been deleted from here. Send the spreadsheet again.
ENVIAR.JA_TRAZIDA: This list has already been brought in. See below.

CLIENTES.DE_NOVO: You changed the column that said who is a customer. Answer again.
CLIENTES.QUAL_COLUNA: Which column says who is a customer?

TELEFONE.TITULO: Whose phone is in the “{coluna}” column?
TELEFONE.DE_NOVO: You changed the phone column. Answer again.

VALORES.PREENCHIDAS: Every row with something written in this column
VALORES.OUTROS: Plus {valores}, {linhas}. To check them all, choose the first option.
VALORES.COLUNA_VAZIA: This column is empty in this spreadsheet. Go back and choose another column, or answer “Not yet”.

FRASE.TOTAL: I found {count} person. | I found {count} people.

CONTADOR.LISTA: What I found in the spreadsheet
CONTADOR.COMPLETADAS: was already here | were already here
CONTADOR.DEIXADAS: was left out | were left out

CONFERIR.SOSSEGO: You can undo this whenever you want.
CONFERIR.NINGUEM: There is no one left to bring in.
CONFERIR.JUNTADAS: I merged {count} row from a person who appeared more than once. | I merged {count} rows from people who appeared more than once.
CONFERIR.CLIENTES: {count} comes in as a customer. | {count} come in as customers.
CONFERIR.SEM_CLIENTES: No one comes in as a customer.
CONFERIR.MUDOU: This list changed while you were checking it. I'm showing how it is now.
CONFERIR.MUDANCA_DESFEITA: I didn't make that change: with it there would be no one left with a phone or e-mail. I left it as it was.
CONFERIR.RELEITURA_PAROU: I haven't finished reading your spreadsheet again yet. What you changed is already saved.
CONFERIR.TRAZER: Bring in {count} person | Bring in {count} people

PRECISAM.PLANILHA_APAGADA: The spreadsheet has already been deleted from here. To fix a line, send the spreadsheet again.
PRECISAM.ERRO_TELEFONE_IGUAL: Fix the phone number to save.
PRECISAM.ERRO_MOSTRAR_MAIS: I couldn't show more. Try again.

ANUNCIO.REABERTA: Line {linha}: back for you to check
ANUNCIO.OUTRO_PROBLEMA: Line {linha}: saved. There is still something else to fix on this line.

PROBLEMA.TELEFONE: {quem}: this phone number doesn't look like a mobile number. Check the digits and the area code: the area code must be together with the number, in the same column.
PROBLEMA.DUPLICADA: {quem} shows up twice. Which one stays?
PROBLEMA.SEM_CONTATO: {quem}: there is no phone or e-mail
PROBLEMA.TELEFONE_FORMULA: {quem}: the phone number starts with a sign (=, +, - or {'@'}). Write it without the sign.
PROBLEMA.EMAIL_FORMULA: {quem}: the e-mail starts with a sign (=, +, - or {'@'}). Write it without the sign.
PROBLEMA.NOME_FORMULA: {quem}: the name starts with a sign (=, +, - or {'@'}). Write it without the sign.
PROBLEMA.FORMULA: On this line, “{campo}” starts with a sign (=, +, - or {'@'}). Fix it in the spreadsheet and send it again, or leave this line out.
PROBLEMA.FORMULA_SEM_CAMPO: On this line, a piece of information starts with a sign (=, +, - or {'@'}). Fix it in the spreadsheet and send it again, or leave this line out.
PROBLEMA.FORMULA_RESUMO: {quem}: a piece of information starts with a sign (=, +, - or {'@'})

RECUSA.TELEFONE: This phone doesn't look like a Brazilian mobile number. Check the area code and the digits.
RECUSA.CONTATO: Write a phone or an e-mail.
RECUSA.FORMULA: This text starts with a sign (=, +, - or {'@'}). Write it without the sign.

CAMPO.TELEFONE: Check this phone and try again.
CAMPO.EMAIL: Check this e-mail and try again.
CAMPO.NOME: Check this name and try again.
CAMPO.LINHA: I couldn't save this row. Try again.

GUARDAR.APOIO: Each column of your spreadsheet and where it goes.
GUARDAR.AJUDA_PARA_QUE_SERVE: A short sentence. E.g.: month the insurance expires.
GUARDAR.ERRO_NOME_DO_CAMPO: Write a name for this information.

ANDAMENTO.APOIO: You can leave this screen. The list shows up down here when it's done.

PRONTO.E_COMPLETADAS: and {count} was completed. | and {count} were completed.
PRONTO.COMPLETADAS: {count} person was completed. | {count} people were completed.
PRONTO.SOSSEGO: You can undo this whenever you want, right below.

HISTORICO.VAZIO: You haven't brought in any list yet.
HISTORICO.FALHOU: I couldn't bring in this list.
HISTORICO.ROTULO_TENTAR: Try bringing in the list {arquivo} again

DESFAZER.TIRA: This removes the person who came with this list and hasn't talked with you yet. | This removes the {count} people who came with this list and haven't talked with you yet.
DESFAZER.FICAM: {count} stays here, because they already talked with you or already got a campaign. | {count} stay here, because they already talked with you or already got a campaign.
DESFAZER.DEVOLVE: The person who was already here goes back to how they were. | The {count} who were already here go back to how they were.
DESFAZER.NAO_RECEBER: People who asked not to get messages stay that way.
DESFAZER.ERRO_PREVIA: I couldn't see what will be removed.

ERROS.GUARDAR: I couldn't save this. Try again.
ERROS.DESFAZER: I couldn't undo this. Try again.
ERROS.TRAZER: I couldn't bring in the list.
ERROS.ANDAMENTO: I couldn't check how it's going.
ERROS.HISTORICO: I couldn't show what you already brought in.
ERROS.NADA_PARA_TRAZER: There is no one left to bring in. Send the spreadsheet again.
ERROS.FALTA_VALORES_CLIENTE: Before bringing in the list, say who is a customer.
ERROS.SEM_EMPRESA: To keep the company phone, the spreadsheet needs a column with the company name.
ERROS.MUITO_LONGO: This text is too long. Shorten it and try again.
ERROS.SEM_COLUNA_DE_CONTATO: I didn't change this column: the list needs at least one phone or e-mail column.
